Subject: Request: one-time stay award & small equity refresh for Sarah Patel (Sr Eng Lead)

Hi Laura / Rishi (cc Aditya),

Short version: Sarah Patel (Sr Eng Lead, Platform) has a counteroffer in hand from a competitor. She's been a high performer and lead for two critical initiatives (KV cache work + inference batching). I recommend a limited, one-time retention package to keep her through the next major milestone (Q4 infra cutover).

Proposal (requesting approvals):
- One-time cash stay award: $45,000 (gross) paid in the next payroll cycle.
- Equity refresh: grant target 0.18% (RSU-equivalent, vesting over 12 months with a 3-month cliff acceleration for 3 months already earned).
- No title change; keep managerial responsibilities intact.

Rationale:
- Replacing Sarah would cost ~6-9 months of hiring ramp + lost feature velocity; risk to infra timeline estimated as high.
- Her direct reports (2 senior engineers) are aligned and retention there depends on leadership continuity.
- Budget note: the cash fits within current hiring flex budget if approved; equity is within comp band exceptions for critical contributors.

Attachments: comp_simulation_sarah_v2.xlsx (breakdown), org-chart-eng-team.pdf

Asking: Laura for People Ops approval / legal checks, Aditya for budget signoff, Rishi for leadership concurrence. If we agree, can we route as an exception packet? I can draft the DocuSign/offer language.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Connor — thanks for the clear write-up and the sims. I reviewed the attachment quickly; high level I support a narrowly scoped package. A few notes and asks before I sign off: 

1) Structure suggestion (People Ops preferred):
   - Cash: $40k one-time (paid next payroll) + $5k deferred retention payable at 6 months (to protect runway).
   - Equity: 0.15% refresh as RSUs with 12-month vesting, but allow a 3-month accelerated tranche to recognize recent contribution (not full acceleration).
2) Compliance/legal: we need HR approval and confirmation there are no policy conflicts. If we treat the deferred $5k as conditional, we can reduce immediate cash outflow.
3) Budget: Aditya — need confirmation which budget line (hiring flex vs retention pool) and whether we can absorb the cash in Q2. See attached simulation.

Connor, please confirm you can accept the above structure if leadership signs off. If yes, I will prepare an exception packet and route to Legal. Katrina Morales (external comp advisor) can be looped for benchmarking if you want—I recommend a short note justifying deviation from guidelines.

—Laura
